about_short_description.short_description: Validere is on a mission to better human prosperity by making the energy supply chain efficient and sustainable.

product.name: Enterprise Asset Management (EAM)
product.description: Software to manage the entire lifecycle of physical assets with configurable inventories, hierarchies, and digital twins for operational workflows.

product.name: Emissions Management Platform
product.description: Integrated platform for tracking, quantifying, and reporting regulatory and voluntary air and greenhouse gas emissions with scenario modeling.

product.name: Asset Optimization
product.description: Toolset for monitoring asset performance using predictive analytics and historical data to forecast maintenance needs and optimize operations.

product.name: Maintenance Scheduling
product.description: Software for real-time scheduling, planning, and dispatching of maintenance and compliance tasks with route and task prioritization.

product.name: Mobile Field Services
product.description: Mobile application enabling field teams to manage assets, access schematics, update inventories, and document inspections from any location, including offline.

product.name: Quality Management and Optimization
product.description: Centralized system for managing quality data from labs and instruments, enabling reporting, analytics, and operational process control.
